basic_details.job_title: UIDAI Assistant Account Officer Recruitment 2027 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) has invited applications on deputation (on Foreign Service terms) for 1 post of Assistant Account Officer in Pay Matrix Level-8 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (₹47,600 – ₹1,51,100), at its Regional Office, Mumbai. The deputation period is five years. Eligible officers apply online on the UIDAI Career Portal (career.uidai.gov.in), and the complete application forwarded through proper channel must be received by 18 January 2027.

age_limit.details: Age must be below 56 years, as on the closing date for the application. The notice prints no age relaxation. Minimum residual service should be 3 years, as on the closing date for the application.

qualification.details: Officers from the Central Government holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre/department, or Officers with three years of regular service in Pay Matrix Level 7 of the 7th CPC (₹44,900 – 1,42,400), or Officers with five years of regular service in Pay Matrix Level 6 (₹35,400 – 1,12,400), or Officers from a State Government, Public Sector Undertaking or Autonomous Organisation holding a regular post in corresponding grades with requisite experience.

how_to_apply: Submit the application online through the UIDAI Career Portal at https://career.uidai.gov.in within the prescribed time limit.
Download or print the filled online application form generated by the portal.
Sign it and give the hard copy to your Cadre Controlling Authority/Parent Organisation for forwarding through proper channel.

The Cadre Controlling Authority/Parent Organisation forwards the attested/certified application with the documents listed below. Applications of individuals whose services cannot be spared by the cadre controlling authority may not be forwarded.

The complete application must be sent to: Director (HR), Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), Regional Office, 7th Floor, MTNL Telephone Exchange, GD Somani Marg, Cuffe Parade, Colaba, Mumbai - 400 005.
The application must be received by 18 January 2027. The notice says applications received after the last date or incomplete may not be considered.
Only applications submitted online and then forwarded through proper channel with all documents will be considered. Online submission alone gives no right to be considered.
Duly filled, signed and attested/certified hard copy of the online application.
Cadre clearance from the Cadre Controlling Authority.
Vigilance/disciplinary clearance in respect of the applicant.
Copies of ACRs/APARs for the last five years, attested on each page by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India or equivalent rank in the parent organisation.
Certificate from the forwarding authority in the format at Annex-I.

On the organisation's letterhead, the certificate states the period for which the officer will be relieved (not less than three years). It also confirms that the officer's information is checked against service records, integrity is certified and no vigilance case is pending or contemplated. It states either that no penalty was imposed in the last 10 years, or encloses the details of penalties. It confirms that ACR/APAR photocopies for the last five years are enclosed.

For members of the IAS, IPS and IFS, the cadre controlling authority means the Department of Personnel and Training, the Ministry of Home Affairs and the Ministry of Environment and Forest respectively. Where no authority is specified, the authority competent to approve relieving on deputation is treated as the cadre controlling authority.
important_instructions: UIDAI reserves the right to withdraw the circular at any time without assigning any reason. UIDAI may post the selected officer at another location, or select a candidate for another location, on grounds of suitability, exigency of service or other administrative reasons. The notice is addressed to Ministries, State Governments, PSUs, banks, LIC, IITs, NITs, IISERs, IIITs, IIMs and Central Universities for wide publicity. For queries, the notice gives the Deputy Director's telephone 011-23478564 and email [email protected]. This is not the address for sending applications.

content_sections.heading: About UIDAI
content_sections.text: UIDAI is established under the Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016 for developing the policy, procedure and systems for issuing Aadhaar numbers to individuals and performing authentication under the Act. The circular was issued from the UIDAI Head Office, 4th Floor, Bangla Sahib Road, Gole Market, New Delhi – 110 001. The notice date is printed as ".11.2026", so the day is not legible.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: This is a deputation vacancy. Private candidates are not eligible. Only officers who have completed at least five years of government service may apply under the Central Government category. Officers from the Central Government holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre/department, or Officers with three years of regular service in Pay Matrix Level 7 of the 7th CPC (₹44,900 – 1,42,400), or Officers with five years of regular service in Pay Matrix Level 6 (₹35,400 – 1,12,400), or Officers from a State Government, Public Sector Undertaking or Autonomous Organisation holding a regular post in corresponding grades with requisite experience. The notice requires one of the following: Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant / MBA (Finance); or Having passed the SAS/equivalent examination of the organised Accounts Cadre of Central/State Government; or Having successfully completed Cash & Accounts Training organised by ISTM; or At least five years' experience in handling accounts related work. Age must be below 56 years, as on the closing date for the application. The notice prints no age relaxation. Minimum residual service should be 3 years, as on the closing date for the application. Basic skills for working in a computerized office environment. Officers holding an analogous post in the parent organisation may be preferred. Individuals who apply may not withdraw their candidature subsequently. For applicants from organisations whose pay structure differs from the Central Government, the notice treats the following PSU grades as equivalent to UIDAI pay levels. Revised pay scales corresponding to these automatically apply if pay is revised. For Level-8, the notice also lists Deputy Manager/Scale-II in Public Sector Banks (Rs.64,820/-93,960/- Revised; Rs.48,170-69,810/- Pre-Revised) and Rs.53,600-1,02,900/- in the Life Insurance Corporation of India. For Level-7 it lists Assistant Manager/Scale-I in Public Sector Banks (Rs.48,480/-85,920/- Revised; Rs.36,000/-63,840/- Pre-revised). Candidates should check paragraph 3.2 of the circular for the full table. For discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should read the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries Pay Matrix Level-8 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (₹47,600 – ₹1,51,100). Recruitment, appointment, salary, allowances, joining time, medical benefits and travelling allowance follow the UIDAI (Appointment of Officers and Employees) Regulations, 2020 and the UIDAI (Salary, Allowances and other Terms and Conditions of Service of Employees) Regulations, 2020, which the notice says are available on www.uidai.gov.in . The period of deputation is five years. The lending organisation may relieve an officer for a lesser period as per its rules, subject to a minimum of three years. Leave is regulated by the Central Civil Services (Leave) Rules, 1972. Terms of deputation are governed by DoPT Office Memorandum no. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II), dated 17.6.2010, and other DoPT orders. If the officer comes from an organisation whose pay structure and/or Dearness Allowance pattern differs from UIDAI, only the pay is protected and not the perquisites. An officer using Central Government Health Scheme facilities in the parent organisation may opt to continue with them, and is also eligible for the UIDAI Medical Reimbursement Scheme.

faq.answer: The deputation period is five years. The lending organisation may relieve an officer for a lesser period as per its rules, subject to a minimum of three years.
